prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Gallium (갈륨) itself — the sovereign of the Gallium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a cute, bright-eyed sweetness; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; oval face; medium-sized eyes — narrow upturned eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; soft rounded brows; upturned nose; a wide mouth with softly upturned corners; vivid blue-violet eyes like a lit LED; a dusting of freckles across nose and cheeks.
Body and hair: petite and short in stature yet voluptuous — a very full, heavy bust, a narrow waist and generously rounded hips on a small, compact frame, with realistic thighs and legs build; a shaggy layered wolf cut with choppy uneven bangs; silky silver-lavender hair glossy as warm liquid metal, with two fine bright violet streaks.
Expression: a small sly smile, bright eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: gallium: a soft bluish-silver metal that melts at about 29.8 degrees Celsius, so a piece held in a warm palm slumps into a bright liquid bead, and that expands as it freezes; predicted in 1871 as eka-aluminium in an empty space below aluminium, then found in 1875 by a French chemist through two faint violet lines in the spectrum of zinc-blende ore from the Pyrenees and named for Gallia, old France; liquid gallium wets glass into a mirror and seeps into aluminium until it crumbles; with arsenic it makes fast chips and space solar cells, with nitrogen the bright blue LED.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Separate bluish mirror-silver armor pieces at the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins over a dark violet-navy fitted inner suit, each piece edged with seams of liquid metal that seem to flow and set again, two thin violet light lines down the chest, vivid LED-blue joints; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: separate armor pieces rather than one shell — plates on the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins, with a dark fitted inner suit showing between them. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: liquid bluish silver, two-line spectral violet, vivid LED blue, warm sunlit gold.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a liquid-metal city: glass tanks where soft robots of warm liquid metal melt, flow through gaps and set again into new shapes, white avenues lit by deep blue-violet LED light, a forming hall where molten silver pours itself into the shape of the next bridge.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ga) and atomic number (31) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
